'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Barry Alperstein LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Barry Alperstein]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers]]
* '''Username:''' MrFromMars
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
